description: This file defines an abstract class 'TokenizeAreaPluginBase' for Drupal views area handlers, providing tokenization and form configuration functionalities.

classes.name: TokenizeAreaPluginBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing tokenization features for Drupal view area handlers.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the plugin, including a 'tokenize' boolean.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form, adding tokenization form elements.

methods.name: tokenForm
methods.description: Adds form elements for tokenization, including available tokens and HTML help.

methods.name: tokenizeValue
methods.description: Replaces tokens in a value with global and view-specific tokens.
